description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity called PrintHtmlFromScreen that demonstrates how to enable printing of HTML content rendered in a WebView. The class loads a local HTML file, sets up a WebViewClient to know when the page is loaded, and provides menu options to print the content using Android's PrintManager.

classes.name: PrintHtmlFromScreen
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating HTML content printing within a WebView. It loads a local HTML file and allows the user to initiate printing via the options menu after the page has loaded.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the WebView, loads the local HTML page, and assigns a WebViewClient to detect when the page finishes loading.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu with a print option only after the web page has finished loading.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu selections, initiating the print process when the print menu item is selected.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Retrieves the Android PrintManager service and starts a print job with the WebView content.
